userTypeSelection.title: Role-Based Statutory Access Gateway
userTypeSelection.subtitle: Select your statutory portal below. Authenticate via JanParichay (National SSO), Mobile SMS OTP, Enterprise Multi-Factor Token, or Statutory CAG Audit PKI.
userTypeSelection.citizenCardDesc: Track land acquisition outcomes: calculated compensation awards, 100% Solatium, PFMS payment records, R&R rehabilitation packages, and file grievances.
userTypeSelection.officerCardDesc: Manage statutory land acquisition lifecycles: proposal scrutinies, Section 11/19 Gazette notifications, cadastral parcel mapping, award determinations, and possession handovers.
userTypeSelection.adminCardDesc: Technical platform operations: API registry management (Bhulekh, Bhoomi, Tamil Nilam), RBAC directory provisioning, tenant configuration, and platform uptime monitoring across national data centres.
userTypeSelection.auditorCardDesc: Statutory oversight and compliance auditing for CAG, State Vigilance, and parliamentary inspection: RFCTLARR timeline audits, Solatium reconciliation, and SHA-256 mutation ledgers.
